definitions.gloss: short essay; essay (for exams or applications)
definitions.explanation: A brief essay, typically written as part of university entrance exams or job applications in Japan. Usually requires the writer to present and argue a position on a given topic.

examples.japanese: {入試|にゅうし}の{小論文|しょうろんぶん}の{対策|たいさく}をしている。
examples.english: I'm preparing for the essay portion of the entrance exam.

examples.japanese: {小論文|しょうろんぶん}は{八百字|はっぴゃくじ}{以内|いない}で{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write the essay in 800 characters or less.

examples.japanese: {小論文|しょうろんぶん}では{自分|じぶん}の{意見|いけん}を{論理的|ろんりてき}に{述|の}べることが{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: In an essay exam, you are required to state your opinion logically.

notes:
USAGE:
A key component of many Japanese university entrance exams and job applications. Unlike {作文|さくぶん} (composition), which is more open-ended and personal, {小論文|しょうろんぶん} requires a structured argument with a clear thesis. Typical length is 600-800 characters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小論文|しょうろんぶん}{対策|たいさく} (essay exam preparation)
- {小論文|しょうろんぶん}を{書|か}く (to write an essay)
- {小論文|しょうろんぶん}{試験|しけん} (essay exam)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {作文|さくぶん}: composition (less formal, more creative)
- {論文|ろんぶん}: thesis, academic paper (longer, more rigorous)
- レポート: report (academic assignment)
